snippet.title: Moonlight Motel Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
It's your first night on the job, and there's a serial killer on the loose.

Step into the shoes of a night receptionist at the Moonlight Motel. Check in guests, keep the business running, and dig into the truth behind the killings. Be careful; there's more to this motel than it seems.
